data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The generator produces a distribution that is determinate but not strictly FAIR: because 2^31 is not divisible by 6, the modular mapping systematically over-represents faces 1 and 2, and this bias is large enough to push count_1 above two standard deviations from the uniform expectation.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The truncated 10000-draw orbit lands by chance on a sub-cycle that is anomalously balanced, keeping count_1 within [1614, 1719].","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The LCG's spectral correlation modulo 6 is weaker than assumed, and the bias is absorbed by normal variance.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The recurrence is implemented with a different seed or modulus, washing out the structural bias.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The modulus 2^31 = 2147483648 leaves a remainder of 2 when divided by 6 (2147483648 = 357913941 * 6 + 2). Consequently, the residues 0 and 1 each occur 357913942 times across the full 2^31 state space, while residues 2, 3, 4, 5 occur only 357913941 times. Under the mapping die_n = 1 + (X_n mod 6), faces 1 and 2 are over-represented by ~1.4 ppm per cycle. Over the full period, this structural bias causes count_1 to exceed the tolerance threshold of 1666.67 \u00b1 52.7. Even though the truncated orbit of 10000 draws does not sample the full space uniformly, the LCG's spectral structure and short cycles modulo 6 prevent the bias from washing out, and count_1 is predicted to land near 1740, well above the upper tolerance of 1719.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
